csv_scope_of_work: The City of Mesa seeks professional consulting services to develop a comprehensive Business Services Department Master Plan that evaluates current and future operational, warehouse, storage, and support facility needs. The study shall assess existing facilities, operational workflows, service demands, site constraints, facility deficiencies, growth projections, and long-term Print, Mail, and Warehouse needs to support City operations over the next 20 years.
